dem.name: LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF
dem.coverage: South polar region; projected bounds -304000 to 304000 metres

inputs.name: Sun/Earth ephemeris (NAIF SPICE, precomputed offline; cross-check: JPL Horizons)

assumptions: Sun and Earth positions come from precomputed ephemeris vectors (offline); no live SPICE on the server.
Geometric visibility treats the Moon as a sphere; terrain-corrected visibility also uses the DEM horizon.
Earth 'visible' means a geometric communication opportunity only, not a radio link (antenna, power and DSN schedule are separate).
No atmospheric refraction (the Moon has no atmosphere).
Preliminary analysis for planning. Not NASA-approved and not flight-certified.

warnings: The source raster reports IAU:30135 while project/M2 uses MOON_ME. This horizon was computed directly in the local raster frame and is preliminary until M2 confirms coordinate-frame compatibility.
Horizon status from terrain module: OK; PENDING_M2_CONFIRMATION.
DEM retrieval time is missing in the horizon file (M3 must fill it).
